advancement: Give or take away advancements from players, one at a time or in whole branches.
attribute: Read or change the attributes of an entity, like its max health, speed or attack damage.
ban: Add a player to the server's ban list, so they can no longer join.
ban-ip: Ban an IP address or a player's address from joining the server.
banlist: Show the players or IP addresses that are banned from the server.
bossbar: Create and change boss bars: their name, color, progress and who can see them.
clear: Remove items from a player's inventory, or count how many there are.
clone: Copy a region of blocks from one place to another.
damage: Hurt an entity by an amount, with a chosen damage type and source.
data: Get, modify and merge the NBT data of a block, entity or storage container, using raw values or other sources.
datapack: List, enable and disable data packs, and set the order they load in.
debug: Start or stop a debug profile of the server.
defaultgamemode: Set the game mode that new players join in.
deop: Take operator status away from a player.
difficulty: Show or set the difficulty of the world.
effect: Give or clear status effects on entities.
enchant: Enchant the item a player is holding.
execute: Run another command with a different executor, position, dimension or condition.
experience: Give, set or count experience points and levels for players.
fill: Fill a region with a block, or replace, hollow or outline what is there.
fillbiome: Change the biome of every block in a region.
forceload: Keep chunks loaded at all times, even with nobody nearby.
function: Run a function from a data pack.
gamemode: Change the game mode of a player: survival, creative, adventure or spectator.
gamerule: Show or change a rule of the game, like keepInventory or doDaylightCycle.
give: Put items into a player's inventory.
help: List the commands you can use, or explain how one of them works.
item: Replace or change items in the slots of a block or entity.
jfr: Start or stop a Java Flight Recorder profile of the server.
kick: Remove a player from the server, with a reason.
list: List the players that are online.
locate: Find the nearest structure, biome or point of interest.
loot: Drop or give items from a loot table, a kill, a mined block or a chest.
me: Send an action message to everyone, like "* name waves".
msg: Send a private message to one or more players.
op: Make a player a server operator.
pardon: Remove a player from the ban list.
pardon-ip: Remove an IP address from the ban list.
particle: Make particles appear at a position.
perf: Start or stop a performance profile of the server.
place: Generate a feature, jigsaw, structure or template in the world.
playsound: Play a sound to players, at a position and volume you choose.
publish: Open the single-player world to your local network.
random: Draw a random number, or roll it into a sequence.
recipe: Give or take away the recipes a player knows.
reload: Reload data packs, loot tables, advancements and functions from disk.
return: Stop a function and give the value it returns.
ride: Make an entity ride another one, or get off it.
save-all: Save the whole world to disk.
save-off: Stop the server from saving the world automatically.
save-on: Let the server save the world automatically again.
say: Send a message to every player on the server.
schedule: Run a function after a delay, or cancel one that is waiting.
scoreboard: Manage objectives and scores, and choose what is shown on the sidebar and tab list.
seed: Show the seed of the world.
setblock: Change one block to another block.
setidletimeout: Set how long a player can be idle before being kicked.
setworldspawn: Set the spawn point of the world.
spawnpoint: Set the spawn point of players.
spectate: Make a spectator watch from the view of another entity.
spreadplayers: Scatter entities to random places around a point.
stopsound: Stop sounds that are playing for players.
summon: Create an entity, with NBT data if you give it.
tag: Add, remove or list the tags on entities.
team: Create and manage teams of players and entities.
teammsg: Send a message to everyone on your team.
teleport: Move entities to a position or to another entity.
tell: Send a private message to one or more players.
tellraw: Send a message written in JSON text, with colors, clicks and hovers.
tick: Show or change the speed the game runs at, and freeze or step it.
time: Show or change the time of day, or the age of the world.
title: Show a title, subtitle or action bar message to players.
tp: Move entities to a position or to another entity.
transfer: Send a player to another server.
trigger: Change a trigger objective's score, when a command has made it yours to change.
w: Send a private message to one or more players.
weather: Set the weather to clear, rain or thunder, and for how long.
whitelist: Control who is allowed to join the server.
worldborder: Set the size, center, damage and warnings of the world border.
xp: Give, set or count experience points and levels for players.
